title: Waiting bookings from earlier days can be cancelled from the Check-in board
also: SCRUM-860 fix carried by the same api deploy: an inbox contact rename's activity row names the conversation on both sides (bcaf07eaf)

deploys.servedNote: The api served b627077e for every step. The till (oto-pos-web-staging) served b627077e for points 1-2 (12:59:03-13:00:00) and most likely 9df18d68 from point 3 on (another lane's deploy went live at 13:00:13). 9df18d68 contains b627077e and changes only the sale writer (SCRUM-887: Till.tsx, saleWriter.ts, gateOnline.ts, SaleWriteStatus.tsx); none of the SCRUM-886 files differ (CancelBookingDialog.tsx, FamilyCheckInCard.tsx, DropOff.tsx, the mobile board files, api checkin.ts). Both bundles carried the SCRUM-886 markers ('Booked for ', 'bookingCheckedIn').

odd.what: A sibling who came and left on an earlier day keeps the booking's Cancel booking disabled with 'Bua is already checked in', though Bua left days ago; such leftovers cannot be cleared from the board. Commit 4fbbe51bb already names this as a rule question for the owner.
odd.where: apps/pos/src/components/dropoff/CancelBookingDialog.tsx:51-52 (cancelBookingBlockedBy, the checked-in line); the api refusal CHECKIN_CANCEL_CHECKED_IN (apps/api/src/services/checkin.ts:775)

odd.what: Not SCRUM-886: a booking paid at the till and left as booked shows 'Overdue - 13:00' on its Upcoming card straight after payment (its booked arrival is the sale time).
